STEP 1 - Scene: A plated dinner of pan-cooked chicken pieces with mushrooms, green beans, and broccoli florets. Nothing else is on the plate.

- Chicken pieces (two, one with a mushroom and green bean on it)
- Broccoli florets (two clusters)
- Green beans (a few strips)
- Mushrooms (small pieces, mostly under the chicken)

- Green beans: ~2% (about 10 cm^2)
- Mushrooms: ~2% (about 10 cm^2)

- Broccoli: 32 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 80 ml
- Green beans: 10 cm^2 x 0.5 cm ≈ 5 ml
- Mushrooms: 10 cm^2 x 1 cm ≈ 10 ml

- Chicken: 114 g x 170 kcal/100 g ≈ 194 kcal

- Green beans: 4 g x 31 kcal/100 g ≈ 1 kcal

- Total: ≈ 211 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Two chicken pieces, a few broccoli florets, and some vegetables make a light portion. About 170 g and about 210 kcal is plausible for what is visible, well below a full plate.
